# pmon_policy (Data Source)

One Cedar policy, by name. Useful for reading a shipped `system:` policy, which cannot be managed as a resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Shipped system: policies are immutable, so they can be read but not managed.
data "pmon_policy" "production_select" {
  name = "system:production-select"
}

output "production_select_is_enabled" {
  value = data.pmon_policy.production_select.enabled
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Policy name.

### Read-Only

- `cedar_src` (String) The Cedar source.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the policy takes part in decisions.
- `id` (Number) pmon's internal id. Shipped policies have negative ids.
- `origin` (String) `SYSTEM` for a shipped policy, which is immutable, or `USER`.
- `system_key` (String) Stable key identifying a shipped policy across upgrades. Null for user policies.
- `updated_at` (String) When the policy was last written.
- `updated_by` (String) Principal that last wrote the policy.
